name: 1248 Pentair FRP Vessel
summary: The Pentair 1248 FRP Pressure Vessel (2739) is a durable 75-litre fiberglass reinforced plastic (FRP) vessel designed for water softeners and filtration systems.
intro: The Pentair 1248 FRP Pressure Vessel is a high-quality 75-litre fiberglass reinforced plastic (FRP) vessel designed for residential, commercial, and industrial water treatment systems. Featuring a durable corrosion-resistant blue FRP body, it is suitable for use with water softeners, sand filters, activated carbon filters, and multimedia filtration systems. With a 10 Bar (150 PSI) pressure rating and top-open 1248 design, it ensures reliable performance, long service life, and easy media loading. Manufactured in India, it is built to deliver dependable filtration in demanding applications.
